title: Thanksgiving
definition: Thanksgiving is the grateful response of believers to God's character, works, gifts, salvation, and daily mercies.
summary: Thanksgiving recognizes God's goodness and responds with gratitude.
christFocus: Jesus gives the greatest reason for thanksgiving by saving sinners and bringing them into God's grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Thanksgiving is more than politeness. It is a spiritual posture that recognizes God as the giver of life, salvation, provision, mercy, and grace.

Believers are called to give thanks in all circumstances, not because every circumstance is easy, but because God remains faithful. Thanksgiving fights entitlement, bitterness, and spiritual forgetfulness.

The Gospel gives thanksgiving its deepest foundation. In Christ, believers have forgiveness, adoption, hope, and eternal life. Gratitude flows from grace received.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Ungratefulness can harden the heart and make people blind to God's kindness. Thanksgiving matters because it trains believers to remember mercy even in hardship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Practice naming specific mercies from God. Turn complaints into prayer, remember the cross, and give thanks privately and publicly for God's faithfulness.
